cohort: Patients undergoing assisted reproductive technologies, divided into a fresh embryo transfer group and a frozen-thawed embryo transfer group.
finding: While the risk of congenital anomalies did not differ, frozen-thawed embryo transfer was associated with higher mean maternal age, lower multiple pregnancy rates, increased mean birth weight, higher cesarean section rates, increased incidence of fetal macrosomia, and decreased incidence of low birth weight compared to fresh embryo transfer.
gest_age: Mentioned as a factor influencing fetal macrosomia, but specific gestational age not provided.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of singleton live births was compared between the groups.
